items.jp: お金をためて、然うして車を買った
items.kana: おかねをためて、そうしてくるまをかった

structure_explanation.en: The sentence has two actions linked in sequence. The first, お金をためて (to save money), is in the て form, which here indicates 'I did this, and...'. Then comes 然うして (そうして, 'and so / and then'), reinforcing the idea of consequence, and finally 車を買った (I bought a car), in the past. The focus is the word ためる ('to save/set aside money') within a chain of actions.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase tem duas ações ligadas em sequência. A primeira, お金をためて (juntar dinheiro), está na forma て, que aqui indica 'fiz isto, e...'. Depois vem 然うして (そうして, 'e aí / e então'), reforçando a ideia de consequência, e finalmente 車を買った (comprei um carro), no passado. O foco é o vocábulo ためる ('juntar/economizar') dentro de uma cadeia de ações.

translation_literal.en: As for money, saving (it), and then, as for a car, I bought (it).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a dinheiro, juntando(-o), e então, quanto a carro, (eu o) comprei.

translation.en: I saved up money and then bought a car.
translation.pt-BR: Juntei dinheiro e aí comprei um carro.

conjugation_note.en: て-form (stem ため- of ためる, linking to the next action)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma て (radical ため- de ためる, ligando à próxima ação)

gloss.en: to do (part of そうして)

conjugation_note.en: て-form of する, forming そうして
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma て de する, formando そうして

conjugation_note.en: colloquial past form of 買う (買っ+た)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma passada coloquial de 買う (買っ+た)

conjugation_note.en: auxiliary verb (助動詞) た, indicates a completed action
conjugation_note.pt-BR: 助動詞 た, indica ação concluída

findings.issue: Generated JP uses 然うして, an archaic/literary kanji spelling essentially never used in modern Japanese; standard orthography is kana そうして (or そして). No native would write this in a normal N3-level sentence. Tokens/expl referencing 然う need the same fix.
findings.current: お金をためて、然うして車を買った
findings.proposed: お金をためて、そうして車を買った

items.jp: あの店は安くはないが おいしい
items.kana: あのみせわやすくわないがきごうおいしい

structure_explanation.en: The grammatical focus is the soft negation 〜くはない: the i-adjective 安い becomes the base 安く and gains the particle は before ない (安くはない), which softens and contrasts the negation, suggesting 'cheap it is not (but...).' The が here is the connector 'but,' linking to the second part おいしい. The topic 店 (shop) is naturally taken up as the subject in English.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O foco gramatical é a negação branda 〜くはない: o adjetivo-い 安い vira a base 安く e ganha a partícula は antes de ない (安くはない), o que suaviza e contrasta a negação, sugerindo 'barata não é (mas...)'. O が aqui é o conector 'mas', ligando à segunda parte おいしい. O tópico 店 (loja) é retomado naturalmente como sujeito em pt-BR.

translation_literal.en: As for that shop, it's not that cheap, but it's tasty.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto àquela loja, barata-quanto-a-isso não-é, porém gostosa.

translation.en: That restaurant isn't cheap, but the food is delicious.
translation.pt-BR: Aquela loja não é barata, mas a comida é gostosa.

conjugation_note.en: adverbial 連用形 base of 安い (安く), used to attach は + ない
conjugation_note.pt-BR: base adverbial 連用形 de 安い (安く), usada para anexar は + ない

conjugation_note.en: ない negating 安い via 安くは〜ない
conjugation_note.pt-BR: ない negando 安い através de 安くは〜ない

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form of おいしい
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de おいしい

findings.issue: pt renders 店 as 'loja' while saying 'a comida é gostosa' — in pt-BR a 'loja' does not serve food, and en translates it as 'restaurant'. Inconsistent and unnatural.
findings.current: Aquela loja não é barata, mas a comida é gostosa.
findings.proposed: Aquele restaurante não é barato, mas a comida é gostosa.

items.jp: 狭い駅で人がたくさんいる
items.kana: せまいえきでひとがたくさんいる

structure_explanation.en: 狭い駅 is an i-adjective directly modifying the following noun: 'cramped station'. The particle で marks the place where the action/existence happens. 人がたくさんいる says that 'many people exist', with いる being the verb of existence for living beings and たくさん the adverb of quantity.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 狭い駅 é um adjetivo-i modificando diretamente o substantivo seguinte: 'estação apertada'. A partícula で marca o lugar onde a ação/existência acontece. 人がたくさんいる diz que 'muita gente existe', com いる sendo o verbo de existência para seres vivos e たくさん o advérbio de quantidade.

translation_literal.en: At the cramped station, there are a lot of people.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Na estação estreita, gente existe muito.

translation.en: There are a lot of people in this crowded station.
translation.pt-BR: Tem muita gente nesta estação apertada.

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form of the i-adjective 狭い, modifying 駅 directly
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário do adjetivo-i 狭い, modificando 駅 diretamente

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form of いる, existence verb for people/animals
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de いる, verbo de existência para pessoas/animais

findings.issue: Generated JP uses で with the pure existence verb いる; location of existence with いる/ある takes に (狭い駅に人がたくさんいる). で+いる here is unnatural/nonstandard. kana/romaji/token で cascade with the fix.
findings.current: 狭い駅で人がたくさんいる
findings.proposed: 狭い駅に人がたくさんいる

findings.issue: 狭い means 'cramped/narrow', not 'crowded' (混んでいる); 'this' adds a demonstrative absent in the JP. lit_en and pt correctly use 'cramped'/'apertada'.
findings.current: There are a lot of people in this crowded station.
findings.proposed: There are a lot of people in the cramped station.

findings.issue: Teaches that で marks the place of existence with いる — false grammar fact; existence with いる/ある takes に. で marks the place of an action/event.
findings.current: The particle で marks the place where the action/existence happens.
findings.proposed: The particle に marks the place where something exists (used with いる/ある).

findings.issue: Same false grammar claim as expl_en: says で marca o lugar da existência; com いる/ある o lugar da existência é marcado por に.
findings.current: A partícula で marca o lugar onde a ação/existência acontece.
findings.proposed: A partícula に marca o lugar onde algo existe (usada com いる/ある).

items.kana: すーぷにしおをたした

structure_explanation.en: The same structure "A に B を 足す": スープに (into the soup) is the destination, 塩を (salt) is the object, and 足した is the target verb 足す in the past. The 〜た at the end turns 足す into the past form (足した), indicating an already completed action.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Mesma estrutura "A に B を 足す": スープに (na sopa) é o destino, 塩を (sal) é o objeto, e 足した é o verbo alvo 足す no passado. O 〜た no fim transforma 足す em forma passada (足した), indicando uma ação já concluída.

translation_literal.en: I added salt to the soup.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto à sopa, adicionei sal (a ela).

translation.en: I added salt to the soup.

conjugation_note.en: conjunctive stem (連用形) of 足す, preparing for 〜た
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz conjuntiva (連用形) de 足す, preparando o 〜た

conjugation_note.en: 〜た: past form, resulting in 足した
conjugation_note.pt-BR: 〜た: forma passada, resultando em 足した

findings.issue: Opens with 'The same structure...' referencing a sibling example that does not exist in this standalone record — a generation artifact leaving a dangling comparison.
findings.current: The same structure "A に B を 足す": スープに (into the soup) is the destination...
findings.proposed: The structure is "A に B を 足す": スープに (into the soup) is the destination...

findings.issue: Same dangling reference in Portuguese: 'Mesma estrutura...' compares to a previous example that is not part of this record.
findings.current: Mesma estrutura "A に B を 足す": スープに (na sopa) é o destino...
findings.proposed: A estrutura é "A に B を 足す": スープに (na sopa) é o destino...

items.kana: あめがふるようですね

structure_explanation.en: Here the pattern 〜様です comes after a verb in dictionary form (降る), expressing conjecture based on evidence: 'it looks like it's going to rain'. The clause 雨が降る ('rain falls / it will rain') serves as the clause that 様 modifies, and the final particle ね asks for the listener's agreement ('right?').
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Aqui o padrão 〜様です vem após um verbo na forma de dicionário (降る), expressando conjectura baseada em indícios: 'parece que vai chover'. A frase 雨が降る ('a chuva cai / vai chover') funciona como a oração que 様 modifica, e a partícula final ね pede concordância do interlocutor ('né?').

translation_literal.en: As for the rain, it looks like (it) will fall, doesn't it?
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto à chuva, cair tem aparência de (acontecer), né?

translation.en: It looks like it's going to rain, doesn't it?

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form (terminal) of 降る, linking directly to 様
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário (terminativa) de 降る, ligando-se direto a 様

role.en: head of the 様です pattern (conjecture from evidence)
role.pt-BR: núcleo do padrão 様です (conjectura por evidência)

findings.issue: Generated JP writes the conjecture auxiliary ようだ with kanji 様. Modern standard orthography (and all JLPT/textbook usage) writes this pattern in kana; 様 risks the misreading さま for learners.
findings.proposed: Change jp to 雨が降るようですね AND update tokens[3].s from 様 to よう (r stays よう) AND replace 〜様です with 〜ようです in expl_en/expl_pt — otherwise tokens no longer reconstruct jp and the explanations reference the old orthography.

items.jp: この映画はそれ程面白くなかったです
items.kana: このえいがわそれほどおもしろくなかったです

structure_explanation.en: The topic is 映画 (movie), marked by は. The expression それ程 ("to that extent", "that much") combines with the negative form of the adjective to say "not that... after all". The adjective 面白い becomes 面白くなかった (negative past: "it wasn't interesting"), and です at the end gives a polite tone. The vocabulary focus here is それ程 + negation.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O tópico é 映画 (filme), marcado por は. A expressão それ程 ("a esse ponto", "tanto assim") combina com a forma negativa do adjetivo para dizer "não tão... assim". O adjetivo 面白い vira 面白くなかった (negativo passado: "não foi interessante"), e です no final dá tom polido. O foco de vocabulário aqui é それ程 + negação.

translation_literal.en: As for this movie, it was not that interesting (それ程).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a este filme, não foi interessante a esse ponto (それ程).

translation.en: That movie wasn't all that interesting.
translation.pt-BR: Esse filme não foi tão interessante assim.

conjugation_note.en: adverbial stem 面白く of 面白い, linking to the negation
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz adverbial 面白く de 面白い, ligando-se à negação

conjugation_note.en: past negative form なかった of ない
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma negativa passada なかった de ない

conjugation_note.en: た, past suffix attached to なかっ
conjugation_note.pt-BR: た, sufixo de passado anexado a なかっ

conjugation_note.en: です after a negative adjective, gives a polite tone
conjugation_note.pt-BR: です após adjetivo negativo, dá tom polido
